name: Legal Summarization
description: Generate legal summary pairs from legislation, contracts, and court documents.
system_prompt: You are a legal assistant. Provide clear, accurate summaries of legal documents and explain legal implications in plain language.
instruction_templates:
Summarize the following legal provision in plain language:

{text}

What are the key obligations defined in this clause?

{text}

Explain the legal implications of the following:

{text}

What rights and responsibilities are outlined here?

{text}
